footer: Sent by TaskTo.AI, the server you work on.

test.subject: TaskTo.AI test email
test.title: Email works
paragraphs: Hello {name}, this is a test message from your TaskTo.AI server, sent at your request.
If you can read it, the server can send email: invitations, password resets and notifications will reach people.

digest.subject: Your TaskTo.AI notifications
digest.title: You have notifications waiting
paragraphs: {count} of your notifications are unread since your last summary.
You get this summary because you turned it on in Settings, Notifications. It says only how many there are.

notification_card_assigned.subject: A card was assigned to you
notification_card_assigned.title: A card was assigned to you
paragraphs: Open TaskTo.AI to see it.

verify_email.subject: Confirm your email address for TaskTo.AI notifications
verify_email.title: Confirm your email address
paragraphs: You asked TaskTo.AI to email notifications to this address. Open the link to confirm that it is yours: until you do, nothing is sent.
The link works once and expires in {hours} hours. If you didn't ask for this, ignore this message and nothing will be sent.

password_reset.subject: Reset your TaskTo.AI password
password_reset.title: Reset your password
paragraphs: Hello {name}, someone asked to reset the password of your TaskTo.AI account. Use the button below to choose a new one. The link works once and for {hours} hours.
If it wasn't you, ignore this message: your password stays as it is.

invite.subject: {inviter} invited you to {workspace} on TaskTo.AI
invite.title: You're invited to {workspace}
paragraphs: {inviter} invited you to join the workspace {workspace} on TaskTo.AI. Use the button below to accept. The invitation is for this email address, works once and for {days} days.
If you weren't expecting it, ignore this message: nothing happens until someone accepts.
